When do I have to object to the 2025 service-charge statement?

response.text:
Your objection is due by Fri 10 Sep 2027 [item:itm_rc1nagh2qjnc]. The letter gives 12 months from receipt for objections, and Ordnung counts that from receipt on Thu 10 Sep 2026.

- To be safe, post it by Mon 6 Sep 2027 so it arrives in time [item:itm_rc1nagh2qjnc].
- The letter says later objections may no longer be considered.
- This deadline doesn't affect the payment. The additional €184.30 is due Fri 9 Oct 2026 [item:itm_dmaw27qvv18n]. Check the statement first if you think it's wrong.

This isn't legal advice. If there's a dispute, consider getting advice.
